title: Input-head rewind machine
statement: For each nonnegative integer $k$, define a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with $k+1$ work tapes and state set $\{0,1,2\}$, initially in state $0$. In state $0$ it moves the input head left and enters state $1$. In state $1$, it moves left and stays in state $1$ when the scanned input cell contains a bit; when that cell is blank, it moves right and enters state $2$. In state $2$ it stays in place and remains in state $2$. In all cases it leaves every work tape unchanged, emits no output, and has a successor state.
